title: Easy Workspace: overview film
description: Review and publish a page in one click. A narrated tour, recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 50 seconds: Easy Workspace for TYPO3 v14. Pending changes, per page; Publish what is ready; No translation left behind; The rest waits for later. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: The Workspaces module lists changes for whole page trees, so editors leave publishing to an admin.
Easy Workspace adds a publishing dropdown to the TYPO3 toolbar.
The toolbar counts the pending changes of the page you are on.
Every change starts selected. Untick what is not ready yet.
Changes in other languages get their own section, and publish with the rest.
Publish, and the unselected changes stay in the workspace.
Easy Workspace, built on TYPO3’s own workspaces.
